kubeconfig.title: Kubeconfig file (leave empty to use KUBECONFIG or ~/.kube/config)

checkDeprecatedApiVersions.title: Report removed or deprecated apiVersions (extensions/v1beta1, batch/v1beta1, ...)

checkDuplicateEnvNames.title: Report an env variable defined twice in one container

checkMissingName.title: Report a built-in resource without metadata.name or generateName

checkMissingSelector.title: Report a Deployment, StatefulSet, DaemonSet or ReplicaSet without spec.selector

checkHelmWhitespaceTrim.title: Report Helm whitespace trim markers written without a space ({{-foo, foo-}})

checkChartKeys.title: Report a Chart.yaml without apiVersion, name or version
